item.title: REF 0.1.0
item.description:
• First release. Drop in a song you want to sound like and a bounce of your mix: REF measures loudness (LUFS, loudness range), true peak, dynamics, tonal balance and stereo width, and tells you in plain English what to change.
  • Suggested EQ moves for the master bus, a match score per area, and charts of where the two differ, across the song and over time.
  • Bounce over the same file and REF measures it again by itself, showing what you fixed.
  • Works on your mix alone too: streaming loudness, true peak, clipping and phase checks.
